title: Linear – The system for product development
description: Linear's live website is a masterclass in minimal, content-forward SaaS design. The page uses a stark dark theme with a deep navy-black background and vibrant cyan-green accent color that immediately communicates a modern, developer-focused product. The hero section features oversized, tightly-kerned typography with the headline rendered as an eye-catching gradient from white to the brand green. Below sits a subdued subheading explaining the product and a clean pill-shaped CTA button. The page employs smooth scroll-triggered animations — content fades and slides into view as the user scrolls, with subtle parallax effects on background elements. Feature sections alternate between full-bleed product UI screenshots and text blocks, showing the actual interface in action. The navigation is a thin, translucent top bar that becomes more opaque on scroll. Below the fold, customer testimonial cards appear with avatar, quote, and company logo in a clean grid. The design language is heavily inspired by the actual Linear app — consistent border radius, monochrome icon set, and the same Inter typography. The footer is minimal with only essential links. The overall experience is fast, focused, and devoid of marketing fluff, letting the product's own design quality sell itself.
primary_use_case: Perfect SaaS landing page template for developer tools and B2B products where the product's own design quality is the primary marketing asset.
style_vibe: Minimal, dark, and design-forward — a developer tools aesthetic that lets product quality and typography do the heavy lifting.
